info.title: Soroban Identity Server API
info.description: Operational REST and GraphQL HTTP service for Soroban Identity contracts, covering Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs), Verifiable Credentials, Webhook delivery, and Reputation systems on Stellar Soroban.

tags.name: credentials
tags.description: Verifiable credential issuance, verification, revocation, and queries

tags.description: Webhook subscription management, delivery logs, and testing

tags.name: identity
tags.description: W3C DID resolution and registry endpoints

200.description: Server and all upstream contracts are healthy

503.description: Server or upstream contracts are degraded

get.description: Retrieves a cursor-paginated list of credentials. Cursors are opaque tokens returned as nextCursor/previousCursor; pass one back as `cursor` (with `direction=next` or `direction=prev`) to continue paging. The response also carries a weak ETag; a matching If-None-Match returns 304.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor/previousCursor

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction to page in relative to cursor. 'prev' walks backward through results in the same forward order.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in each returned credential, e.g. 'id,subject,claims.tier'. Omit to receive the full object.

ETag.description: Weak entity tag for this page. Send back via If-None-Match to revalidate.

304.description: Not Modified - the caller's If-None-Match matches the current page.

get.description: Retrieves the full record of an existing credential.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response, e.g. 'id,claims.tier'. Supports dotted paths into nested objects.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Conditional GET. When it matches the current strong ETag, the server returns 304 with no body.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag for the canonical credential state (computed the same way regardless of any `fields` filtering). Reuse it in If-Match on a later write.

304.description: Not Modified - If-None-Match matched the current ETag.

delete.description: Marks the credential as revoked in persistent storage and dispatches a `credential.revoked` webhook notification.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optimistic concurrency. When present, the revoke is rejected with 412 unless it matches the credential's current ETag.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid API key

412.description: Precondition Failed - If-Match did not match the credential's current ETag.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid API key
Unauthorized - missing or invalid API key

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the credential to verify

get.description: W3C DID Resolution endpoint for did:stellar identifiers.

post.description: Dynamically registers a client for the authorization code grant. The client_secret is returned only in this response and cannot be retrieved again.

scopes.description: Subset of the API's scopes this client may ever be granted.

get.description: Issues a short-lived authorization code and redirects to redirect_uri. There is no separate login/consent page: the resource owner is whoever this request is already authenticated as, and a requested scope can never exceed both the client's registered scopes and the caller's own.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Space-delimited scopes. Defaults to the client's full registered scope set.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Opaque value echoed back unchanged, to protect against CSRF.

302.description: Redirect to redirect_uri with code and state query parameters.

400.description: Invalid request, unknown client, or unregistered redirect_uri

403.description: Caller does not hold a requested scope

post.description: Exchanges an authorization code, or a refresh token, for an access token. Accepts a JSON body (not the RFC 6749 form-encoding) to match the rest of this API.

redirect_uri.description: Required for grant_type=authorization_code; must match the value used at /oauth/authorize

scope.description: Optional on refresh; may only narrow the original grant

post.description: Reports whether a token is currently active. Callers authenticate either as the OAuth client the token was issued to (client_id/client_secret in the body) or as an admin (admin:read).

Revokes an access or refresh token. Always responds 200 once the caller's own credentials check out, whether or not the token was recognized, so a caller cannot use this endpoint to probe for valid tokens.

post.summary: Verify multiple credentials in a single batch request
post.description: Verifies up to 50 credentials in a single request for efficiency with partial success handling.

400.description: Invalid request format or limit exceeded

post.description: Issue an API key with configurable permissions and subscription tier.

get.description: Returns metadata for all issued API keys.

post.summary: Execute multiple credential operations in one request (#749)
post.description: Processes up to 100 issue/verify/revoke operations in a single request, returning one result per operation. Partial failures do not abort the batch unless `atomic` is true, in which case the batch stops at the first failure and rolls back any credentials it already issued in this batch.

atomic.description: Stop at the first failure and revoke any credentials issued earlier in this batch, instead of continuing through the remaining operations.

id.description: Optional client-supplied reference echoed back on the matching result.

payload.description: issue: a full credential body. verify/revoke: { credentialId }.

200.description: Batch processed; check each result's `success` field for its individual outcome.

400.description: Invalid batch: empty, over 100 operations, or a malformed operation

403.description: Missing credentials:read/credentials:write scope for the operation types present

get.description: Returns the caller's daily and monthly quota usage for its subscription tier. Independent of rate limiting (X-RateLimit-* headers), which is a separate, rolling per-minute budget.

resetAt.description: Unix seconds, 1st of next UTC month

get.description: Alternative to the GET /events SSE stream for clients that cannot hold an open text/event-stream connection. Holds the request open until at least one matching event arrives or the timeout elapses, then responds once with a JSON batch and closes.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: Filter to events from one contract.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Requested timeout in milliseconds, clamped to [1000, LONG_POLL_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS] (default 30000, max 60000).

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Ledger cursor to resume from; also accepted as a `lastEventId` or `since` query param.

200.description: One batch of matching events, or an empty batch if the request timed out first.

lastEventId.description: Cursor to send back on the next call.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API Key token (e.g. `secret_key:credentials:read,credentials:write` or admin key).

subject.description: Stellar public address of the credential subject

issuer.description: Stellar public address of the credential issuer

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds (0 = no expiry)

verified.description: True if valid, active, and unexpired
